source.text: The auditor tested 40 sampled users from a population of 1,842 active NetSuite users. For 36 sampled users, access was reviewed and approved. For 3 sampled users, manager approval was not documented. For 1 sampled user, Billing Administrator access was retained without documented business justification. Management stated that missing approvals were due to manager turnover and that Billing Administrator access is being reviewed by IT and Finance. Follow-up is expected next quarter.

draft.text:
Objective
The purpose of this audit was to evaluate user access provisioning and review controls in NetSuite.

Scope & Methodology
The auditor tested 40 sampled users from a population of 1,842 active NetSuite users. Attributes tested included access review approvals, documented business justification, and manager sign-off.

Results
For 36 sampled users, access was reviewed and approved. For 3 sampled users, manager approval was not documented. For 1 sampled user, Billing Administrator access was retained without documented business justification.

Management Response
Management stated that missing approvals were due to manager turnover and that Billing Administrator access is being reviewed by IT and Finance. Audit will perform follow-up procedures next quarter to ensure appropriate documentation is retained.
